description:
Can You Keep A Secret? premieres February 12 on Paramount+.

Domineering granny Debbie Fendon, a woman who will stop at nothing to protect her family – is just the person they most need protecting from. When her hermit-like husband, William unexpectedly dies, she makes an outlandish decision that will put the family under more pressure than ever before. Because William isn’t actually dead – he just got mistakenly declared it and has been living in the loft while they wait for the life insurance to pay out. This comes as a bit of a shock to their easily frazzled son, Harold, whose wife, Neha works for the local police. Just as they come to terms with the baffling behavior of these geriatric toddlers, Debbie reveals another secret she's been keeping up her sleeve - and this one could bring the whole family down.
